Three Cousins Die in Bike Accident During Navratri Celebrations

Navratri celebrations in Rajnandgaon turned to mourning after a road accident claimed the lives of three cousins. Their speeding motorcycle collided with a stationary truck, and they succumbed to their injuries during treatment. Another report mentioned a labourer falling from a three-story building and dying during Navratri.
